scripts.setup: npm install && cd frontend && npm install && cp -n .env.example .env.local; cd ../web_landing && npm install; cd ../admin_dashboard && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend,admin -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:admin-ui"
scripts.dev:ios: concurrently -n backend,frontend,admin -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend:ios" "npm run dev:admin-ui"
scripts.dev:android: concurrently -n backend,frontend,admin -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend:android" "npm run dev:admin-ui"
scripts.dev:admin: concurrently -n backend,admin -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:backend" "cd admin_dashboard && npm run dev"
